case_scope: Employee ownership and broad-based equity wealth formation

workplace_power_gate.note: Employee ownership is a plausible wealth-formation rail, but it must be scored as claim design: who participates, how much value is real, when it becomes liquid, and whether workers have voice.

worker_ownership_breadth.note: Breadth must be measured by wage tier, tenure, part-time status, race, gender, establishment size, and excluded-worker categories.

profit_sharing_or_broad_based_equity.note: Broad-based equity/profit sharing only improves the verdict if contributions are material, enforceable, and not substituted for wages or benefits.

employee_ownership_liquidity_and_concent.note: ESOP/employee-ownership value is vulnerable to valuation disputes, diversification limits, repurchase obligations, firm failure, and delayed payout.

worker_voice_in_firm_governance.note: Ownership cannot be counted as control without board, trustee, voting, information, and grievance/voice evidence. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: OECD stewardship evidence is now bound to the worker-voice/governance conversion burden.

proof_debt: account balances and contribution value by wage/tenure group
vesting, forfeiture, diversification, and payout timing
valuation disputes and trustee governance quality
worker voice and control rights separate from financial ownership

gate_14_workplace_power.why: Employee ownership helps only when broad, material, liquid, protected, and accompanied by worker voice; current evidence does not yet prove that distribution.

gate_19_intergenerational_transfer.why: Backloaded ownership wealth can affect family transfers only if vesting, liquidity, and diversification survive employment and firm-risk shocks.

evidence_debt_register.question: account balances and contribution value by wage/tenure group
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect Form 5500/plan, establishment, and worker-level data to test whether ownership is broad and material.

evidence_debt_register.question: vesting, forfeiture, diversification, and payout timing
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Determine when workers actually own and can convert value, including terminated-worker payout delays.

evidence_debt_register.question: valuation disputes and trustee governance quality
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect DOL enforcement, litigation, and valuation-practice evidence for ESOP transaction pricing and trustee conduct.

evidence_debt_register.question: firm-failure and concentration-risk protection
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure participant exposure to employer-stock concentration, repurchase obligations, and downturn/failure scenarios.

evidence_debt_register.question: worker voice and control rights
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Document whether employee ownership includes voting, board representation, information rights, and collective voice.

policy_pathway: Treat employee ownership as a high-upside but design-sensitive claim, not as automatic worker control or wealth equality.
Show broad worker participation, material account balances, fair valuation, timely liquidity, diversification, and governance voice.
